headline: The first trials were only for gain of function variants. The CEO tells the families who were left out that a second study, the 102 study, is coming, and why.
story: The non gain of function study matters to the company and to families across the GRIN community who are waiting.
Their first work was for gain of function variants. More work showed they may help more of the community, so the 102 study will test that.
Families who could not join the Honeycomb and Beeline studies now have something on the way.
